svg.aria-label: A free-form plate united with its mirror image: the plate's side face crosses the mirror plane at a small angle, and kentron's union keeps the parts of the two side faces that lie inside the other half.
svg.text: A plate and its mirror image
4 fragments of the side faces are kept
inside the solid: 0.14 of area too much
Why: a section across the plane
distances from the plane drawn 30× larger
in red: the parts of the side faces that kentron
keeps, each inside the other half
